label: Held under fire
description: Come through a crisis in the field with a soldier covering the commander and win the fight. Outsiders see the commander at the front, not a figurehead.

label: Won by order
description: Secure a command mission after giving at least one combat order yourself. Outsiders see who gave the orders.

label: Talked it through
description: Settle a decision with a passed social check or social route. Outsiders see who does the talking.
